profile.reading: This Iron Mountain facility is part of the company data center business, which traces to a December 2017 purchase of IO Data Centers United States division for 1.3 billion dollars, acquiring four colocation data centers in New Jersey, Ohio, and Arizona, though this specific Virginia or Illinois location was not confirmed as part of that transaction in available sourcing this session. Iron Mountain itself was founded in 1951 as Iron Mountain Atomic Storage Corporation by Herman Knaust, a former mushroom entrepreneur who had purchased a depleted iron ore mine near Kingston, New York, went public in 1996, became a real estate investment trust in 2014, and as of 2023 is headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. No building specific address, acquisition story, or individual MW figures for this particular registry row were located in available sourcing this session.
